description: This file serves as an initialization script for the 'xtts' service in a Python project. It imports the 'sys' module and a 'DeprecatedModuleProxy' class from 'pipecat.services', then imports all symbols from the local 'tts' module. It replaces the module in 'sys.modules' with a deprecated proxy, likely to handle deprecation warnings or transitions.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A class used to create a proxy for deprecated modules to handle deprecation warnings or transition logic.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
methods.description: Constructor for the DeprecatedModuleProxy class, used to create a proxy object that manages access to deprecated modules.
